system.description: On an Accuracy, Magic or contested Check, spend 1 Fabula Point and invoke one of the target's Traits: +(SL) to your Result against that target. A Villain may spend an Ultima Point to cancel. The Miasma clause is struck (13 Aug 2026): that spend no longer ticks the Miasma Clock.
